previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A woman with end-stage renal disease, previously on peritoneal dialysis, was admitted for revision of a non-functional left radiocephalic arteriovenous fistula due to poor inflow and multiple stenotic areas. She desired transition to hemodialysis as her current regimen was burdensome. She underwent surgical revision with ligation of side branches and re-routing of inflow due to complete stenosis of the radial artery proximal to the anastomosis. The procedure was successful, with palpable thrill and audible bruit postoperatively. She remained stable overnight without complications and was discharged home with instructions to monitor the access site, protect the arm, and follow up with the access clinic. Her home medications were continued without changes.
